findings.title: Route is attached to no Gateway
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop has no parentRefs, so it is attached to no Gateway, and no Gateway sends it a request

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-route-no-parent -o jsonpath='{.spec.parentRefs}'

findings.fix: Add a parentRef to HTTPRoute shop naming the Gateway (and its listener, by sectionName) that should serve it; kubectl get gateways -A lists them.
